target.tool: Customer-verified business interface; effectivity-reference restrictions apply

key.note: Preserve source identifiers in an audit ledger; map regenerated internal IDs and target numbering. Never assume internal IDs survive migration.

structures.preprocessing: Unscoped candidate rows. Approve the full-key population at cutover; use customer-cohort-project.json. BOMs and routings need key date, engineering change, usage, alternative and selected-node resolution. Preserve alternative sequences and dependencies. Production orders are process references unless the chosen target interface explicitly supports their state; confirmations, goods movements and costs must not be reposted as master data. Verify production-version validity, lot-size ranges, lock/check status and the effective BOM/task-list combination. Materials and plants are cross-domain prerequisites. Distinct production versions may intentionally overlap; evaluate availability for a version identity rather than rejecting every material-level overlap. REM planning levels require release-specific interface review.
